issues.description: The meal expense appears to be a personal meal expense that will need to be grossed up as it does not qualify as a business entertainment expense with third party involvement.

validation_result.compliance_summary: This receipt from Italy for Global People ICP fails compliance validation due to multiple critical issues. The document is missing mandatory Local Employer information (name, address, VAT number, and tax code). The cash payment method doesn't meet traceability requirements. The expense appears to be a personal meal that will need to be grossed up for tax purposes, unless documentation proving business entertainment with third parties is provided. These issues must be addressed to ensure tax compliance and proper expense processing.
